stem: A moisture sensor is moved into a different substrate and begins reporting unfamiliar values. What should happen before using those values as absolute scheduling targets?
choices: Verify sensor behavior and establish context/reference behavior in the new substrate
Apply the same raw-value targets from the previous substrate
Change several schedule variables at once
rationale: Sensor output can depend on substrate and installation. Verification and contextual reference behavior are needed before treating raw readings as absolute targets.
